Maharashtra Speaker Addresses Mumbai Power Crisis with MLAs

The Speaker of the Maharashtra Legislative Assembly convened a meeting with all-party Members of the Legislative Assembly (MLAs) to discuss the ongoing power crisis in Mumbai. The Speaker also summoned the General Manager of BEST, the city's transport and electricity provider, citing failures in resolving power outages in South Mumbai.
